## 🛡️ CISO Security Posture Workbook

**Audience:** CISO · SOC Manager · Security Steering Committee

**Question this workbook answers:** *"What are my biggest risks, how are they trending, and what should I fix next — in less than 5 minutes?"*

Use the **Tabs** below to drill from executive view → topic deep-dives. Set the **Window** parameter once and it propagates to every panel. The **📚 Data Sources** tab documents every table, query, and caveat used.

🛡️ CISO Security Posture — Executive Dashboard
Window: {Window:label} vs prior bucket of equal length · Severity: {SeverityFilter:label} · ▲ increase from prior · ▼ decrease

📋 What this workbook does
A single board-level view of security posture across identity, endpoint, email, data & AI, and detection coverage. All KPIs are computed live from Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR — no manual aggregation, no hand-edited values. Every tile is reproducible by selecting Edit → KQL.
1 · Executive Posture
Overall posture score · KPI tiles (incidents, MTTR, backlog) · severity & classification trends · attention list of long-running incidents.
Tables: SecurityIncident · SecurityAlert · SentinelHealth
2 · Top Risks & Impact
Crown-jewel assets at risk · user risk concentration · MTTD / MTTR / dwell time · improving vs degrading domains · True-Positive rate · single points of failure.
Tables: SecurityIncident · SecurityAlert · IdentityInfo · DeviceInfo · AADUserRiskEvents
3 · Threat & MTTR
Incident lifecycle · response-time percentiles · top recurring scenarios · severity-weighted trends.
Tables: SecurityIncident · SecurityAlert
4 · Identity & Access
Risky sign-ins · Identity Protection detections · UEBA anomalies · privileged-account exposure · geographic patterns · early- vs late-stage compromise.
Tables: SigninLogs · AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs · AADUserRiskEvents · AuditLogs · IdentityInfo · BehaviorAnalytics · Signinlogs_Anomalies_KQL_CL
5 · Data & AI Risk
🤖 3-source AI hybrid — SaaS (CloudAppEvents) + Federated (SigninLogs/Non-interactive) + Endpoint (DeviceNetworkEvents) · sanctioned vs federated vs shadow AI · AI by category (LLM / Code / Image / MCP-Agent / Search) · newly-seen AI apps vs 90d baseline · risky-user × AI overlap · DLP outcome split · repeat violators.
Tables: CloudAppEvents · SigninLogs · AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs · DeviceNetworkEvents · SecurityAlert (DLP/Purview/Insider Risk) · AADUserRiskEvents · OfficeActivity
6 · Coverage, Health & Cost
Analytic-rule health (SentinelHealth) · detection coverage % · ingestion volumes & anomalies · license benefit analysis · tier-migration candidates.
Tables: SentinelHealth · Usage · Operation · Heartbeat · LAQueryLogs
🎯 MITRE Coverage
Tactic & technique coverage · rule effectiveness vs ATT&CK · gaps and blind spots.
Tables: SecurityAlert (Techniques column) · SentinelHealth
✉️ Email & Collab
Inbound mail flow · phishing & ZAP effectiveness · Safe Links clicks · email authentication (DMARC/DKIM/SPF) · repeat clickers · top campaigns.
Tables: EmailEvents · EmailPostDeliveryEvents · UrlClickEvents · EmailAttachmentInfo · EmailUrlInfo
⚙️ Required data sources & connectors
Microsoft Sentinel
SecurityIncident · SecurityAlert · SentinelHealth · Usage · Operation · LAQueryLogs · Heartbeat
Microsoft Entra ID
SigninLogs · AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs · AADUserRiskEvents · AuditLogs (Azure Active Directory connector)
Microsoft Defender XDR
IdentityInfo · DeviceInfo · BehaviorAnalytics · CloudAppEvents · DeviceNetworkEvents (Microsoft Defender XDR connector — DeviceNetworkEvents required for endpoint-side shadow AI detection)
Defender for Office 365
EmailEvents · EmailPostDeliveryEvents · UrlClickEvents · EmailAttachmentInfo · EmailUrlInfo
Office 365 / Exchange
OfficeActivity (Office 365 connector — required for mailbox-rule signals)
Custom (optional)
Signinlogs_Anomalies_KQL_CL — hourly anomaly KQL job (skill: scope-drift-detection/user)
How to use: Use the Window and Severity filters above to scope all tabs. Tiles compare current vs the prior period of equal length — look for ▲ increases in volume/severity (worse) and ▼ decreases in MTTR/backlog (better). Hover any chart for tooltips; click Edit on a tile to see the underlying KQL and adapt thresholds. Color codes: 🔴 high risk · 🟠 medium · 🟡 low · 🟢 mitigating / sanctioned · 🔵 informational. 🎯 Top Risks & Business Impact
Top alert detections in window · Business Impact derived from Tactics and ProductName · Window: {Window:label} · Severity: {SeverityFilter:label}

content.query:
let win = {Window};
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(win)
| where AlertSeverity in ({SeverityFilter})
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| summarize Alerts = count(), Severity = any(AlertSeverity), Tactics = any(Tactics), ProductName = any(ProductName) by AlertName

    Tactics has 'Impact', '🔴 Operational · disruption',
    '🟡 Other')
| order by Alerts desc
| take 15

What changed — biggest deltas vs prior {Window:label}

content.json:
### 🧮 Composite Risk Score

**Risk Score = Likelihood × Impact × Exposure**, normalized 0–100. Computed per period from `SecurityIncident` (Likelihood = incident rate, Impact = severity-weighted, Exposure = distinct entities). Trend arrow compares **current window** vs **prior window of equal length**.

### 🔁 Repeat vs New Risks

A detection (`AlertName`) is **recurring** if it fired in both the current and prior window of equal length. **Net-new** = first time seen in the current window. High recurrence ⇒ unresolved control failure.

content.title: Detection lifecycle — recurring vs net-new (top 25 by current volume)

content.json:
### 💎 Assets at Risk — Business-Critical

Tier-0 / crown-jewel inventory pulled from `IdentityInfo` (privileged Entra roles) and `DeviceInfo` (devices flagged as critical or high-value). "At Risk" = entity appears in a `SecurityAlert` or `SecurityIncident` within the window.

### 👥 User Risk Concentration

What **share of high-risk users hold privileged roles?** Above ~10 % indicates that risk is concentrated in your most powerful accounts — a fragility signal.

### ⏱️ Time to Detect vs Time to Respond

**MTTD** = median time from `FirstActivityTime` → `CreatedTime` (how fast we detect after the attack starts). **MTTR** = median time from `CreatedTime` → `ClosedTime` (how fast we close once we know). CISO target: minimize **dwell time** = MTTD + MTTR.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(2*win)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| extend MTTD_min = datetime_diff('minute', CreatedTime, FirstActivityTime),
         MTTR_min = iff(Status == 'Closed' and isnotempty(ClosedTime), datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime), int(null)),
         Bucket   = iff(CreatedTime > ago(win), 'Current', 'Prior')
| where MTTD_min >= 0
| summarize MTTD_hours = round(percentile(MTTD_min, 50) / 60.0, 1),
            MTTR_hours = round(percentile(MTTR_min, 50) / 60.0, 1),
            DwellTime_hours = round((percentile(MTTD_min, 50) + percentile(MTTR_min, 50)) / 60.0, 1),
            Incidents = count() by Bucket
| order by Bucket asc
content.title: MTTD / MTTR / Dwell Time — current vs prior {Window:label}

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let bucket = case(win <= 1d, 1h, win <= 7d, 6h, win <= 30d, 1d, 7d);
SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(win)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| extend MTTD_min = datetime_diff('minute', CreatedTime, FirstActivityTime),
         MTTR_min = iff(Status == 'Closed' and isnotempty(ClosedTime), datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime), int(null))
| where MTTD_min >= 0
| summarize MTTD_hrs = round(percentile(MTTD_min, 50) / 60.0, 1),
            MTTR_hrs = round(percentile(MTTR_min, 50) / 60.0, 1) by bin(CreatedTime, bucket)
| order by CreatedTime asc
content.title: MTTD vs MTTR trend

content.json:
### 📈 Top Improving vs Degrading Areas

Incident volume per **risk domain** (Identity / Endpoint / Email / Cloud / Network / Data) — current window vs prior window of equal length. Negative `Δ%` = improvement.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let classify = (p:string, t:string) {
  case(
    p has_any ('Identity Protection','Azure Active Directory','Microsoft Entra'), 'Identity',
    p has_any ('Defender for Endpoint','MDATP'), 'Endpoint',
    p has_any ('Defender for Office','Defender for O365','Office 365'), 'Email',
    p has_any ('Defender for Cloud Apps','MCAS','Cloud App'), 'Cloud Apps',
    p has 'Defender for Cloud', 'Cloud Workload',
    t has 'Exfiltration' or t has 'Collection', 'Data',
    'Other')
};
let base = SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2*win)
| where AlertSeverity in ({SeverityFilter})
| extend Domain = classify(tostring(ProductName), tostring(Tactics)),
         Bucket = iff(TimeGenerated > ago(win), 'Current', 'Prior');
base
| summarize Alerts = count() by Domain, Bucket
| evaluate pivot(Bucket, sum(Alerts))
| extend Current = coalesce(Current, 0), Prior = coalesce(Prior, 0)
| extend Delta = Current - Prior, DeltaPct = iff(Prior == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * (Current - Prior) / Prior, 1))
| extend Trend = case(Delta < 0, '🟢 Improving', Delta > 0, '🔴 Degrading', '⚪ Flat')
| project Domain, Current, Prior, Delta, DeltaPct, Trend
| order by Delta desc
content.title: Risk domain trend — current vs prior {Window:label}

content.json:
### 🛡️ Control Effectiveness — Stopped vs Detected vs Missed

From `SecurityIncident.Classification`: **Stopped/TP** = TruePositive (control caught real threat); **Benign** = real activity but not malicious (auto-suppressed FP); **Missed/FP** = FalsePositive that wasted analyst time. Higher TP-rate = better detection ROI.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(win)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| extend Outcome = case(
    Classification == 'TruePositive', '🛑 Stopped (TP)',
    Classification == 'BenignPositive', '🟡 Benign Positive',
    Classification == 'FalsePositive', '🔴 Missed/FP',
    Status == 'Closed', '⚪ Closed (unclassified)',
    '🔵 Open / In progress')
| summarize Count = count() by Outcome
| order by Count desc
content.title: Outcome distribution

content.json:
### 🎯 Risk Concentration Index & Single Points of Failure

**Concentration Index** = % of total alerts attributable to the **top 5 entities** (users, hosts, IPs). Above ~40 % = fragile posture, a small set of compromised entities would cascade. **SPOF** lists privileged identities or critical devices that combine high privilege with active risk signals.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(win)
| where AlertSeverity in ({SeverityFilter})
| extend E = extract_all(@'"(?:UserPrincipalName|AccountUpn|HostName|Address)":"([^"]+)"', tostring(Entities))
| mv-expand E to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(E)
| summarize Alerts = count(), Severities = make_set(AlertSeverity, 5), Sources = make_set(ProductName, 5) by Entity = tolower(E)
| top 10 by Alerts desc
content.title: Top 10 risk-bearing entities (drives Concentration Index)

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let privRoles = dynamic(['Global Administrator','Privileged Role Administrator','Security Administrator','Application Administrator','Cloud Application Administrator','Exchange Administrator','SharePoint Administrator','User Administrator','Conditional Access Administrator','Authentication Administrator','Hybrid Identity Administrator','Intune Administrator']);
let privUsers = IdentityInfo
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AccountUPN
| mv-expand Role = AssignedRoles to typeof(string)
| where Role in (privRoles)
| summarize PrivilegedRoles = make_set(Role, 5) by UPN = tolower(AccountUPN);
let alertsByUser = SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(win)
| where AlertSeverity in ({SeverityFilter})
| extend E = extract_all(@'"(?:UserPrincipalName|AccountUpn)":"([^"]+)"', tostring(Entities))
| mv-expand E to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(E)
| summarize Alerts = count(), Sev = make_set(AlertSeverity, 3) by UPN = tolower(E);
privUsers
| join kind=inner alertsByUser on UPN
| project UPN, Alerts, Severities = Sev, PrivilegedRoles
| order by Alerts desc
| take 15
content.title: 🚨 Single Points of Failure — privileged identities with active risk signals

content.json:
### ✅ Top 5 Risk Reduction Actions

Derived from the KPIs above. Update each cycle as posture improves.

| # | Action | Type | Driving KPI |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Tier-0 PIM enforcement** — convert standing privileged role assignments to PIM-eligible with approval. | 🟢 Quick win | *User Risk Concentration* > 10% |
| 2 | **Tune top recurring detection** — review the #1 row in *Recurring Risks* table; either fix root cause or suppress noise. | 🟢 Quick win | *Recurrence Rate %* |
| 3 | **Reduce SPOF blast-radius** — apply Conditional Access "high-risk user" block + token revocation to the SPOF list above. | 🟡 Strategic | *Single Points of Failure* count |
| 4 | **Close MTTR gap** — automate top 3 incident types via Logic Apps / playbooks; target MTTR ≤ 4h. | 🟡 Strategic | *MTTD/MTTR* trend |
| 5 | **Improve degrading domain** — invest in the top "🔴 Degrading" domain from *Risk Domain Trend* (e.g., Endpoint hardening, Email policy review). | 🔵 Investment | *Top Improving vs Degrading* |

*Annotate the workbook (Edit → Pin) once an action is completed. CISO should review this list every steering committee.*

⚡ Threat Landscape & Incident Response
Severity & MTTR trends · classification mix · daily incident volume · Window: {Window:label}

content.json:
### 📊 Detection Effectiveness — Signal Quality Trend

Daily **TP-Rate %** and **FP-Rate %** computed from `SecurityIncident.Classification`. Rising TP / falling FP = detection-engineering wins. Companion to the snapshot tiles on the *Top Risks* tab — this view shows the **direction** over time.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let bucket = case(win <= 1d, 1h, win <= 7d, 6h, win <= 30d, 1d, 7d);
SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(win)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| where isnotempty(Classification)
| summarize TP = countif(Classification == 'TruePositive'),
            FP = countif(Classification == 'FalsePositive'),
            BP = countif(Classification == 'BenignPositive'),
            Total = count()
  by bin(CreatedTime, bucket)
| extend ['TP %'] = round(100.0 * TP / Total, 1),
         ['FP %'] = round(100.0 * FP / Total, 1),
         ['BP %'] = round(100.0 * BP / Total, 1)
| project CreatedTime, ['TP %'], ['FP %'], ['BP %']
| order by CreatedTime asc
content.title: TP / FP / BP rate trend (% of classified incidents)
Alert→Incident conversion ratio (alerts per incident)

content.json: How to read conversion ratio: Healthy SOCs sit at 3 – 15 alerts per incident. > 50 = noisy detections (tune); < 1.5 = possible under-triaging or fusion not correlating.

### 🛑 Time to Contain (TTC) vs MTTR

**TTC** = time from incident creation → **last malicious activity observed** (max `SecurityAlert.TimeGenerated` for alerts in the incident). **MTTR** (above) = time to admin closure. TTC is what the CISO cares about — *when did the attacker actually stop?*

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let inc = SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(win)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| project IncidentNumber, Severity, CreatedTime, ClosedTime, Status, AlertIds;
let lastAlert = inc
| mv-expand AlertId = AlertIds to typeof(string)
| join kind=inner (SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(win + 7d) | project SystemAlertId, AlertTime = TimeGenerated) on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
| summarize LastMaliciousTime = max(AlertTime) by IncidentNumber, Severity, CreatedTime, ClosedTime, Status;
lastAlert
| extend TTC_min  = datetime_diff('minute', LastMaliciousTime, CreatedTime),
         MTTR_min = iff(Status == 'Closed' and isnotempty(ClosedTime), datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime), int(null))
| where TTC_min >= 0
| summarize TTC_p50_h  = round(percentile(TTC_min, 50) / 60.0, 2),
            TTC_p90_h  = round(percentile(TTC_min, 90) / 60.0, 2),
            MTTR_p50_h = round(percentile(MTTR_min, 50) / 60.0, 2),
            MTTR_p90_h = round(percentile(MTTR_min, 90) / 60.0, 2),
            Incidents  = count() by Severity
| order by Severity asc
content.title: TTC vs MTTR — percentiles by severity (hours)

content.json:
### 🔁 Reopened Incidents — Investigation Quality Signal

An incident is counted as **reopened** if it was set to *Closed* at any point but its current `Status` is *New* or *Active*. High reopen rate = premature closure or weak investigation.

content.title: Reopen rate
Reopened incidents — most recent

content.json:
### 📥 Incident Backlog — Aging & SOC Capacity

Open incidents (`Status` ≠ Closed) bucketed by **age**. The shape of this distribution tells you whether the SOC is **draining** the queue or **drowning**.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status != 'Closed'
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| extend AgeHours = datetime_diff('hour', now(), CreatedTime)
| extend AgeBucket = case(
    AgeHours < 24,    '1 · < 24h',
    AgeHours < 72,    '2 · 1–3 days',
    AgeHours < 168,   '3 · 3–7 days',
    AgeHours < 720,   '4 · 7–30 days',
                       '5 · > 30 days')
| summarize Open = count() by AgeBucket, Severity
| order by AgeBucket asc
content.title: Open incidents by age bucket × severity
Throughput — opened vs closed (Net > 0 = backlog growing)

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(win)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(parse_json(tostring(Owner)).assignedTo), tostring(parse_json(tostring(Owner)).userPrincipalName), '⚪ Unassigned')
| summarize Total = count(),
            Closed = countif(Status == 'Closed'),
            Open = countif(Status != 'Closed'),
            ClosedRatePct = round(100.0 * countif(Status == 'Closed') / count(), 0) by OwnerName
| order by Total desc
| take 15
content.title: Incidents per analyst (workload distribution)

content.json:
### 🎯 Threat Progression — How Far Attacks Get

**Multi-stage incidents** = incidents whose alerts touch ≥ 2 distinct MITRE tactics. **Late-stage** = alerts in `LateralMovement`, `Collection`, `Exfiltration`, or `Impact`. Higher % late-stage = attackers reaching crown-jewel territory before being stopped.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let lateStage = dynamic(['LateralMovement','Collection','Exfiltration','Impact']);
let incTactics = SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(win)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| mv-expand AlertId = AlertIds to typeof(string)
| join kind=inner (SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(win + 7d) | project SystemAlertId, Tactics) on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
| extend T = split(Tactics, ',')
| mv-expand T to typeof(string)
| extend Tactic = trim(' ', T)
| where isnotempty(Tactic)
| summarize Tactics = make_set(Tactic), TacticCount = dcount(Tactic) by IncidentNumber;
let total       = toscalar(incTactics | count);
let multiStage  = toscalar(incTactics | where TacticCount >= 2 | count);
let veryDeep    = toscalar(incTactics | where TacticCount >= 4 | count);
let lateReached = toscalar(incTactics | where Tactics has_any (lateStage) | count);
union
  (print Order=1, Metric='Total Incidents (with mapped tactics)', Value=tolong(coalesce(total,0)),       Sub='denominator'),
  (print Order=2, Metric='Multi-Stage (≥ 2 tactics)',             Value=tolong(coalesce(multiStage,0)),  Sub=strcat(tostring(iff(total==0,0,toint(round(100.0*multiStage/total,0)))), '% of incidents')),
  (print Order=3, Metric='Deep Multi-Stage (≥ 4 tactics)',        Value=tolong(coalesce(veryDeep,0)),    Sub='likely intrusion campaigns'),
  (print Order=4, Metric='Reached Late-Stage Tactic',             Value=tolong(coalesce(lateReached,0)), Sub=strcat(tostring(iff(total==0,0,toint(round(100.0*lateReached/total,0)))), '% — Lat. Mov / Coll / Exfil / Impact'))
| project Order, Metric, Value, Sub
| order by Order asc

### 🌐 Detection Source — Vendor vs Internal Capability

Where do incidents come from? Heavy dependence on a single vendor (e.g. *Microsoft 365 Defender*) is a concentration risk; healthy mix includes custom Sentinel scheduled rules and threat-intel matches.

content.json:
### 🚨 High-Severity Escalation — Critical Handling

**Escalation Time** = creation → first `LastModifiedTime` change for *High* severity incidents (proxy for first analyst touch). **Unhandled** = High severity still in `Status == 'New'` after 4 h. Both are board-visible risk signals.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(win)
| where Severity == 'High'
| summarize FirstTouch = min(LastModifiedTime), CreatedTime = min(CreatedTime) by IncidentNumber
| extend EscalationMin = datetime_diff('minute', FirstTouch, CreatedTime)
| where EscalationMin >= 0
| summarize Incidents = count(),
            P50_min = percentile(EscalationMin, 50),
            P90_min = percentile(EscalationMin, 90),
            Over_4h = countif(EscalationMin > 240),
            Over_24h = countif(EscalationMin > 1440)
| project ['High-Sev Incidents'] = Incidents,
          ['P50 Escalation (min)'] = P50_min,
          ['P90 Escalation (min)'] = P90_min,
          ['> 4h to first touch'] = Over_4h,
          ['> 24h to first touch'] = Over_24h
content.title: High-Sev escalation

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity == 'High'
| where Status == 'New'
| extend AgeHours = datetime_diff('hour', now(), CreatedTime)
| where AgeHours >= 4
| project IncidentNumber, Title, AgeHours, CreatedTime, Owner = tostring(Owner), ProviderIncidentId
| order by AgeHours desc

content.json:
### 🔊 Top Noisy Rules — FP-Weighted

Analytics rules generating the most incidents, ranked by **FP-weighted noise score** = `Incidents × (1 + FP Rate)`. Targets for tuning. Different from *What changed* on the Risks tab — that compares rule volume across periods; this ranks pure operational noise.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(win)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| mv-expand AlertId = AlertIds to typeof(string)
| join kind=inner (SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(win + 7d) | project SystemAlertId, AlertName, ProductName) on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
| summarize Incidents = dcount(IncidentNumber),
            FPCount   = dcountif(IncidentNumber, Classification == 'FalsePositive'),
            TPCount   = dcountif(IncidentNumber, Classification == 'TruePositive'),
            Classified = dcountif(IncidentNumber, isnotempty(Classification)),
            Source    = any(ProductName)
  by AlertName
| extend FPRate = iff(Classified == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * FPCount / Classified, 1))
| extend NoiseScore = toint(round(Incidents * (1.0 + FPRate / 100.0), 0))
| project AlertName, Source, Incidents, ['TP'] = TPCount, ['FP'] = FPCount, ['FP %'] = FPRate, NoiseScore
| order by NoiseScore desc
| take 20
content.title: Top 20 noisy rules — tune these first

#### � Flagged sessions — *who* is being targeted

Volume + geography above tells *where*. These tiles tell *who matters*: **% of flagged sessions tied to privileged or already-high-risk users**.

### 🎯 Identity Risk Posture Score — KEY KPI

**% of total identities** showing **any** risk signal across `SigninLogs.RiskLevelDuringSignIn`, `AADUserRiskEvents` (Identity Protection) and `BehaviorAnalytics` (UEBA). Single board-level number for *“how much of our workforce is currently flagged?”*

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let bucket = case(win <= 1d, 1h, win <= 7d, 6h, win <= 30d, 1d, 7d);
let totalIds = toscalar(IdentityInfo | summarize dcount(tolower(AccountUPN)));
union
  (SigninLogs       | where TimeGenerated > ago(win) | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ('high','medium','low') | project T = TimeGenerated, U = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Series = '🟠 Risky Sign-Ins'),
  (AADUserRiskEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(win) | project T = TimeGenerated, U = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Series = '🔴 Identity Protection'),
  (BehaviorAnalytics | where TimeGenerated > ago(win) | where InvestigationPriority >= 5 | project T = TimeGenerated, U = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Series = '🟡 UEBA Anomalies')
| summarize Users = dcount(U) by bin(T, bucket), Series
| extend ['% of identities'] = round(100.0 * Users / iff(totalIds == 0, 1, totalIds), 2)
| project T, Series, ['% of identities']
| order by T asc
content.title: Risky identity activity over time (% of identities, normalized)

content.json:
### 👑 Privileged Identity Risk Exposure

Not all risk is equal. Risk that lands on **privileged accounts** (any directory role from `IdentityInfo.AssignedRoles`) is what kills the org. These tiles show how much of the privileged population is currently affected.

### 🪤 Identity Compromise — Early vs Late stage

For each incident touching an identity entity, classify by the **furthest tactic** an alert reached. **Early** = caught at initial access / brute force. **Mid** = persistence / cred access / lateral movement. **Late** = collection / exfil / impact (damage zone). High *Early %* = controls catch attacks before harm.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let idAlertKeywords = dynamic(['signin','sign-in','login','identity','user','credential','password','MFA','token','impossible travel','OAuth','consent','inbox','account']);
SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime > ago(win)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ({SeverityFilter})
| mv-expand AlertId = AlertIds to typeof(string)
| join kind=inner (SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(win + 7d) | project SystemAlertId, AlertName, Tactics) on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
| where AlertName has_any (idAlertKeywords) or Tactics has_any ('InitialAccess','CredentialAccess','Persistence','PrivilegeEscalation','LateralMovement','Collection','Exfiltration','Impact')
| extend StageRank = case(
    Tactics has_any ('Exfiltration','Impact','Collection'),                                           3,
    Tactics has_any ('LateralMovement','PrivilegeEscalation','Persistence','CredentialAccess','DefenseEvasion','Discovery'), 2,
    Tactics has_any ('InitialAccess','Reconnaissance','ResourceDevelopment'),                          1,
    1)
| summarize MaxStage = max(StageRank) by IncidentNumber
| extend Stage = case(MaxStage == 3, '🔴 Late (damage zone)', MaxStage == 2, '🟠 Mid (foothold)', '🟢 Early (caught)')
| summarize Incidents = count() by Stage
| order by Stage asc
content.title: Identity-related incidents by furthest stage reached

content.json: How to read: A healthy identity programme keeps ≥ 70 % of identity incidents in the green zone. Anything in red means the attacker reached collection/exfil/impact before being stopped — usually a CA-policy or detection-coverage gap.

### 🪪 Persistence & Account-Takeover Signals

Classic post-compromise persistence: **inbox rules** (auto-forward / hide), **MFA / auth-method changes**, **new app or SPN credentials**. Spikes here after a risky sign-in = account takeover.

content.title: Account-takeover persistence events over time

content.json:
### 🤖 Service Principal (Workload Identity) Risk

Non-human identities are often blind spots. Composite **Risk Score** = `Sign-ins/100 + (Creds Added × 5) + (Failed × 2) + (Distinct Locations × 3)`. Sort top 20 — that's your workload-identity hot list.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let credAdds = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(win)
| where OperationName has 'add' and OperationName has_any ('credentials','client secret','certificate','keyCredential','passwordCredential')
| extend Target = tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources))[0].displayName)
| where isnotempty(Target)
| summarize CredsAdded = count() by Target;
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(win)
| extend Country = tostring(parse_json(tostring(LocationDetails)).countryOrRegion)
| summarize Signins = count(),
            Failed  = countif(ResultType != 0),
            Countries = dcountif(Country, isnotempty(Country))
  by ServicePrincipalName
| join kind=leftouter credAdds on $left.ServicePrincipalName == $right.Target
| extend RiskScore = toint(round(Signins/100.0 + (coalesce(CredsAdded,0) * 5) + (Failed * 2) + (Countries * 3), 0))
| project ServicePrincipalName, Signins, Failed, ['Distinct Countries'] = Countries, ['Creds Added'] = coalesce(CredsAdded,0), RiskScore
| order by RiskScore desc
| take 20
content.title: Top 20 risky service principals

content.json:
### 🪨 Identity Concentration Risk

Fragility check — what share of total identity risk is concentrated on a handful of users or apps? **High concentration** = removing/securing a few entities meaningfully reduces exposure (also: single-points-of-failure).

### 🌍 External Identity Threat Pressure

Where is the attack pressure coming from? Risky sign-ins originating from **TI-flagged IPs** or **high-risk countries** vs internal/expected geos. Trend tells you whether external pressure is rising or falling.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let bucket = case(win <= 1d, 1h, win <= 7d, 6h, win <= 30d, 1d, 7d);
let highRisk = dynamic(['CN','RU','KP','IR','BY','VE','SY','CU']);
let ti = ThreatIntelligenceIndicator | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where ExpirationDateTime > now() | where isnotempty(NetworkIP) or isnotempty(NetworkSourceIP) | extend IP = coalesce(NetworkIP, NetworkSourceIP) | distinct IP;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(win)
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ('high','medium','low')
| extend Country = tostring(parse_json(tostring(LocationDetails)).countryOrRegion)
| extend Origin = case(
    IPAddress in (ti),                            '🚨 TI-flagged IP',
    Country in (highRisk),                         '🚩 High-risk country',
    isempty(Country) or Country in ('Unknown',''), '❓ Unknown / VPN',
                                                   '🌍 Other external')
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, bucket), Origin
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Risky sign-in origin trend

content.json:
### 💤 Dormant but Active Identities

Classic compromise signal: an account silent for **≥ 30 days** that suddenly authenticates — especially with risk. Often abandoned employees, service accounts repurposed, or successful cred theft on stale identities.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let activeRecent = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(win)
| summarize FirstRecent = min(TimeGenerated),
            Total = count(),
            Risky = countif(RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ('high','medium','low'))
  by User = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
let historic = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(180d) .. ago(win))
| summarize LastSeenBefore = max(TimeGenerated) by User = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
activeRecent
| join kind=leftouter historic on User
| extend DaysDormant = iff(isempty(LastSeenBefore), 999, datetime_diff('day', FirstRecent, LastSeenBefore))
| where DaysDormant >= 30
| project User, DaysDormant, ['Recent Sign-Ins'] = Total, ['Risky Sign-Ins'] = Risky, ['Last Seen Before'] = LastSeenBefore
| order by ['Risky Sign-Ins'] desc, DaysDormant desc
| take 30
content.title: Dormant identities (≥ 30 d silent) now active in window

content.json:
### 🔄 Identity Lifecycle Risk

Deleted-then-recreated accounts (new ObjectId for the same UPN) and accounts with multiple object identities over time. **Impact:** Sentinel correlations break — an attacker re-creating a cleaned-up account effectively wipes its history.

content.query:
let win = totimespan({Window});
let deletes = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(win)
| where OperationName has 'Delete user'
| extend UPN = tolower(tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources))[0].userPrincipalName))
| where isnotempty(UPN)
| summarize Deleted = count(), LastDelete = max(TimeGenerated) by UPN;
let adds = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(win)
| where OperationName has_any ('Add user','Invite external user','Restore user')
| extend UPN = tolower(tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources))[0].userPrincipalName))
| where isnotempty(UPN)
| summarize Created = count(), FirstCreate = min(TimeGenerated) by UPN;
let multiId = IdentityInfo
| summarize ObjectIds = dcount(AccountObjectId), Names = make_set(AccountUPN, 5) by Department = tostring(coalesce(Department,''))
| where ObjectIds > 0
| project Note = 'see UPNs with multiple Object IDs in IdentityInfo';
deletes
| join kind=inner adds on UPN
| where FirstCreate >= LastDelete
| project UPN, Pattern = '🔄 Recreated (new ObjectId)', Deleted, Created, LastDelete, FirstCreate
| union (
    IdentityInfo
    | summarize ObjectIds = dcount(AccountObjectId), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UPN = tolower(AccountUPN)
    | where ObjectIds > 1
    | project UPN, Pattern = strcat('🪪 Multiple ObjectIds (', tostring(ObjectIds), ')'), Deleted = int(null), Created = int(null), LastDelete = datetime(null), FirstCreate = FirstSeen
)
| order by Pattern asc, UPN asc
| take 30
content.title: Recreated accounts & UPNs with multiple ObjectIds — traceability gaps

content.json:
### 🛡️ Identity Control Effectiveness

For every risky sign-in: was it **blocked** by a control (CA / MFA / lockout) or did it **succeed**? **MFA effectiveness** = of risky sign-ins that *required* MFA, what % actually succeeded after MFA. Answers: *“are our identity controls working?”*

Sensitive data exposure · DLP policy matches · AI agent posture · ⚠️ DataSecurityEvents/AIAgentsInfo are Advanced Hunting only · Window: {Window:label}
